openings.claim: One authoritative desk ledger, numbered confirmations and a dated online copy may reduce conflicting expectations.
openings.discriminator: Record disagreements decline; conflicts with matching confirmations weaken the explanation.
openings.probe: Reconstruct three conflicts; track confirmed bookings, changes and cancellations, subsequent conflicts and weekly administration.
openings.uncertainty: Desk maintenance feasibility and net time savings are unknown.

openings.claim: Compatible vacancies versus occupied acceptable windows distinguish reassignment opportunities from timing or equipment scarcity.
openings.discriminator: Needs and equipment mapping reveals whether unused hours are usable.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints through bounded feasibility mapping.
openings.probe: Ask every contact for weekly needs, all acceptable windows and equipment; calculate maximum attainable coverage within protected commitments.
openings.uncertainty: Needs accuracy unknown; absence does not release bookings, and outside rehearsals do not establish satisfied needs.

openings.claim: Fixed-time capability reservations with consented room exchanges may accommodate piano-dependent requests.
openings.discriminator: Refusals become feasible without losing another group's acceptable time or required equipment.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints if exchanges are confirmed before arrival.
openings.probe: Resolve blank equipment fields; replay nine refusals across both rooms; count feasible exchanges and effort. Pilot confirmed exchanges with matching calendars and telephone or in-person confirmation.
openings.uncertainty: Room preferences may be nonnegotiable; administrative fit remains unproven.

openings.claim: Shared essential musicians may make simultaneous group reservations unusable.
openings.discriminator: Late or missed sessions coincide disproportionately with shared-member commitments compared with attended sessions.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints in a paper scheduling test.
openings.probe: Ask session-specific causes and clash-free windows; test a schedule avoiding confirmed clashes; record interview and rescheduling time.
openings.uncertainty: Member overlap is unobserved; recall and correlation cannot establish causation.

decision: Measure feasibility first. All tests retain two rooms, 24 staffed hours, requested weekly 60-minute access, telephone/in-person changes, existing equipment, no new fees and both performances. No opening demonstrates eight-week targets: needs coverage is unknown; three conflicts and 127.5 weekly administration minutes exceed targets.
